conviction_note: Two measurements that roughly agree. The findings net to -0.5: a soft Q3 revenue line (management guided only 'a month and a bit' of B300 billing, and the Q3 bar is disputed at $18.3m/$25.3m) and a Q4 street of $88.6m that two halls still energising in November put at risk, set against a low real bar after a 59% fall since 6 Oct, short float up to 14.5% and non-dilutive GPU debt. The scaled number is p_up 48 x abs_move 17, so -0.68. The disputed bar and the crowded short pulled p_up toward 50. abs_move sits above the 13.5% event-implied move: this is the first real revenue-ramp quarter, there are no prior prints on EDGAR, and 20-day realised vol is 161%.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue. Earnings Whispers consensus $18.33m, EPS -$1.47 (https://beta.earningswhispers.com/go/w/SHAZ, read 2026-11-16). Benzinga shows $25.3m for Q3 and $88.6m for Q4 (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/SHAZ/earnings-forecasts, snippet_only: the page returned 403). The two quarterly sources disagree by about 38%, so the bar is disputed and every finding that depends on it is capped small. I sized against $18.3m, the lower and more recently dated figure.

expectations.real_bar: The market holds a low bar. For the stock to rise, the release has to show the contracted clusters actually energised and billing (ESDS live after its 16 Sep delivery date, the $950m customer ramping), a Q4/2027 ramp that has not slipped, and cash after Q3 capex that covers the build without new equity. A Q3 revenue figure near $18-25m matters less than those.

next_guide.company_current_guide: No numeric guide. Qualitative only: 'revenue expected to ramp materially from Q3 2026 through 2027' (Q2 release, 2026-08-06), and on the Q2 call 'the first material revenue to commence in Q4 2026 as large-scale B300 and GB300 deployments come online'. Target of more than 68,000 GPUs by mid-2027, raised from 64,000 on 2026-10-01.
next_guide.basis: The company has never given a numeric guide, so a 'maintain the qualitative ramp' is the base case. The risk is a slip: the 6 Nov report of management's late-October update says 9 halls were energised, 2 were due in November and 1 was still under construction, and the CEO named data-centre readiness and hardware delivery as the ramp risks. Against that, the GPU target was raised on 1 Oct and a $356m GPU facility was signed for a customer contract.

findings.finding: The real bar is low. The stock fell from $48.12 (2026-10-06) to $19.86 (2026-11-16), down 59% and 12% on the print day itself. That puts market cap at about $760m on 38.34m shares (13D/A share count), against $1.9bn of cash at June 30 and ~$1.04bn face of convertible notes. The press attributes the fall to 'potential data center delays' and a 'funding gap', without a named source or company disclosure. A release that shows clusters billing and cash covering the build clears the bar the market holds, which is far below the stale $105 mean target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is only one prior print as a listed company with results on record (Q2, 2026-08-06), and it was sold: about -5% on 08-07, with -57% drift since. The name gave back a +13% sympathy rally on CoreWeave within two sessions (11-11 to 11-13).
findings.why_not_priced: The price is the expectation itself, so this finding is about what the price assumes, not about an unseen fact. The size is small because the skew (+32 vol points, downside paid) says the option market expects more downside. If the market had priced a clean Q4 ramp, the stock would sit nearer its $48 level from early October.
findings.independence: Cause of the fall per press: https://cryptobriefing.com/sharonai-holdings-shares-plunge-52-percent/ (2026-11-04). Share count from the 13D/A: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2068385/000093583626000500/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X02/primary_doc.xml. Cash at Q2 from https://quartr.com/events/sharonai-holdings-inc-shaz-q2-2026_FRcIPO5A. Q3 capex has consumed an unknown share of that cash, which is why the size is small.

findings.finding: Q3 revenue is likely to land at or below the disputed bar ($18.3m Earnings Whispers, $25.3m Benzinga). On the Q2 call (2026-08-06) the CEO said Q3 carries only 'a full month and a bit of billing' for the B300 cluster handed over in July, and that 'the first material revenue' commences in Q4. Q3 upside depends on the $950m customer's first phase (accepted 2026-08-20, revenue 'phased across Q3 and Q4') and on ESDS's 8,200-GPU B300 cluster, whose delivery was due 16 Sep. I found no confirmation that ESDS went live, and short seller Bleecker Street (30 Apr) questioned ESDS's capacity to pay. My read: about $15-20m, so roughly -8% against $18.3m and a clear miss against $25.3m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 revenue of $1.93m against ~$7.5m consensus was sold: about -5% on 2026-08-07, then -57% drift.
findings.why_not_priced: The two estimate sources disagree, so the street may still carry a $25m number that management never endorsed. If the market had priced a Q3 miss, the higher estimate would have been cut to match the Earnings Whispers figure. Capped small because the bar is disputed and the company already told the market material revenue comes in Q4, so a miss lands inside what management said.
findings.independence: The $950m acceptance is from a separate company release: https://finviz.com/news/384019/sharon-ai-successfully-delivers-ai-cloud-deployment-for-global-technology-customer (2026-08-20). ESDS timing: https://convergedigest.com/sharon-ai-planss-8k-b300-gpu-cluster-in-australia/ (2026-04-02). Bleecker Street on ESDS: https://bollwerk.ai/blog/shaz-bleecker-street-short-report/ (2026-05-01).

findings.finding: The Q4 ramp the street models ($88.6m Q4, $118.6m FY2026, so H2 needs about $115m against $1.9m in Q2) is exposed to energisation timing. Per a 6 Nov report of management's late-October update, 212 MW is secured across 12 AU/NZ sites and 120 MW is contracted, but grid power reaches the data hall at only 9 sites, 2 halls were scheduled for November and 1 was still under construction. The CEO named 'hardware delivery and data center readiness' as the two ramp risks. A Q4 or 2027 timing push is the main way this print disappoints.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q2 call reframed 'material revenue' from Q3 to Q4, and the stock fell after the release (about -5% on 08-07). There is no numeric-guide history.
findings.why_not_priced: The street's Q4 $88.6m and the $105 targets have not moved with the stock, so the sell-side has not cut. If the market fully priced a slip, the remaining 'delay' fear would show up as estimate cuts, and none are visible. The stock's 59% fall and the +32 skew say much of it is already in the price, and short float is 14.5%, so the size is moderate.
findings.independence: Same concern stated by the CEO on the Q2 call (https://allmind.ai/earnings/event/2951556, 2026-08-06) and by the press (https://cryptobriefing.com/sharonai-holdings-shares-plunge-52-percent/, 2026-11-04). The halls detail rests on one German secondary source, and no 8-K for the late-October update was found on EDGAR.

findings.finding: After Q3 (8-K filed 2026-10-01, agreement dated 28 Sep), two subsidiaries signed up to $356m of senior secured, GPU-backed SPV term loans at 7.25-9.95% fixed. The loans are 42-month bullet maturities with a limited, releasable parent guarantee that becomes non-recourse once Facility A is repaid. Proceeds buy servers and GPUs for a named customer compute contract. Management called it the first of a series and raised the target to more than 68,000 GPUs by mid-2027, from 64,000. That is non-dilutive funding for contracted demand and answers part of the 'funding gap' narrative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On the announcement the stock went from $54.60 (09-30) to $48.12 (10-06) and then collapsed in mid-October, so the market did not reward it at the time.
findings.why_not_priced: The facility is public. What is not yet visible is whether the call frames it as closing the funding gap, together with Q3-end cash after capex. The October sell-off on 'funding gap' fears came after this facility was announced, which suggests the market has not credited it. Sized small because financing only matters through the ramp it buys.
findings.independence: Company release: https://finviz.com/news/397531/sharon-ai-enters-into-gpu-backed-debt-facility-expanding-funding-flexibility-for-ai-factory-deployments (2026-10-01). Same event, so these are one fact.

findings.finding: The first phase of the 5-year, ~$950m contract with a 'global technology company' was delivered and accepted by the customer on 2026-08-20, which also triggered release of cash security from escrow. Revenue on it was stated to start phased across Q3 and Q4 2026. At full run-rate the contract is ~$190m a year, ~$16m a month. This is a real billing source inside Q3 beyond the July cluster.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No separate history; contract announcements have been sold or faded (a 22% fall on 2026-07-28 in the week of the $1.32bn contract, per Quiver).
findings.why_not_priced: The release gave no GPU count and no billing amount, so nobody can size the Q3 contribution. It may be why one consensus source sits at $25m. This only offsets part of the Q3-revenue finding above. It is a different document, but both findings land on the same line.
findings.independence: Q2 call: Q3 billing is 'a month and a bit' on the July cluster (https://allmind.ai/earnings/event/2951556), which points the other way on Q3 magnitude.

findings.finding: Q3 GAAP results will very likely carry a large non-cash fair-value GAIN on the convertible notes. The stock fell 35%, from $84.66 (06-30) to $54.60 (09-30). Q2 carried a $400.4m fair-value LOSS when the stock rose, which drove a $430.4m net loss. The notes are $350m 6% due 2031 (conversion about $31) and $691.7m 4.75% due 2032 (about $26.6). The GAAP headline could therefore show net income against a -$1.47 EPS consensus, a mechanical headline beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2's $400m fair-value loss produced an EPS 'miss' headline. The stock fell, but on revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: Headline EPS scrapers may print a large 'beat' after hours. Below operating income, with no path to the guide, so sized at a fraction.

findings.finding: CoreWeave (2026-11-10) beat Q3 revenue (~$3.66bn against ~$3.54bn), raised full-year guidance, and said demand outstrips capacity. Nebius (Q3) missed but signed a $3bn Meta deal. SHAZ rallied 13% on 11-11 in sympathy and gave it all back by 11-16. Neocloud demand is confirmed, but the read-through has not held on this name.
findings.link: Same business, renting NVIDIA Blackwell GPU capacity under take-or-pay contracts. Different geography (US/EU against AU/NZ), no shared named customers, and no revenue-share figure.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The peer sympathy on 11-11 (+13%) fully reversed within three sessions.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock already traded the read-through and rejected it. SHAZ's issue is its own execution, not demand.

findings.finding: Short interest is building into the print: 14.52% of float and 2.4 days to cover (finviz, 2026-11-16), up from about 6.6% of float and 1.3 days in mid-September and 2.57m shares in mid-July. Open interest is call-heavy (put/call 0.15). Any release that defuses the delay or funding narrative has a short-cover mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No squeeze observed on this name yet. The 11-11 sympathy spike (+13% intraday-to-close) shows how fast it can move on a positive.
findings.why_not_priced: The skew (+32, downside paid) prices the downside tail. A squeeze would show up in call skew and borrow fee, and I could not read the borrow fee because curvedtrading returned 403. At 14.5% the short is below the 18-23% levels that squeezed in the lessons, so the size is moderate.

findings.finding: There is a large registered resale overhang. The 2026-10-07 424B3s cover 5.30m plus 8.06m Class A shares for resale, and the convertibles convert into up to 37.3m shares, against 38.34m shares outstanding. Situational Awareness LP holds 21.1% (8.07m shares; it paid $523.9m, about $65 a share, and exercised its last 2.67m pre-funded warrants on 2026-09-15). It has registration rights and says it may sell or hedge.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A 22.2% fall on 2026-07-28 was attributed to 'dilution and resale-overhang concerns' (Quiver).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced; it is a known overhang. It would matter inside the window only if the release or call disclosed new equity or an ATM, and none was found on EDGAR through 2026-10-07. Shrunk for the crowded short.
findings.independence: Resale registrations: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2068385/000149315226046082/form424b3.htm (2026-10-07). Quiver on the overhang: https://www.quiverquant.com/news/SharonAI+Holdings+Slides+22.2%25+as+Investors+Weigh+Dilution+Risk+and+Near-Term+Uncertainty (2026-07-28).

findings.finding: On 2026-09-20 the company dismissed its auditor HoganTaylor, which had flagged a material weakness in the FY2025 10-K, and engaged EY effective 2026-09-23 to review the upcoming 10-Q and audit FY2026. HoganTaylor reported no disagreements. The Q3 10-Q, EY's first review, is due about now (the 45-day deadline of 14 Nov falls on a Saturday, so 16 Nov). A late filing (NT 10-Q) or a restated item is a small tail risk.
findings.why_not_priced: It is an upgrade to a Big Four auditor, which is neutral to positive for credibility. The risk is only the first-review timing, and it would show up only if the 10-Q is not filed with the release.

findings.finding: Co-founder COO Andrew Leece was moved to 'Head of Strategic Partnerships' on a fixed term ending 2027-03-31. Most of his RSUs were forfeited, and mutual releases and non-disparagement were signed. David Burns became COO effective 2026-09-07, in the middle of the deployment ramp.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since September, and the terms (mutual releases, forfeited RSUs) read as a negotiated exit. It matters only if the call ties delays to the operating handover.

findings.finding: On its only prior print as a listed operator (Q2, released 2026-08-06), the name missed revenue consensus ($1.93m against ~$7.5m) and was sold: about -5% on 08-07 to $49.52, with -57% drift since. The reaction function so far punishes the gap between the contract book and revenue.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This finding is the reaction history.
findings.why_not_priced: History only. It informs the reaction, not the number, and there is one observation.

outside_window.finding: Founders' lock-ups extended to 2027-03-31 (with the April Oaktree convertible). Expiry falls after the window.
The 40,000-GPU NVIDIA allocation ($4.9bn TCV) deploys over H1 2027, per the Q2 call. Its revenue falls outside this window except through guidance.

searched_and_found_nothing: Mid-quarter statements: after the last call (2026-08-06), found the 2026-08-20 $950m first-phase acceptance, the 2026-09-04 Rafay deal, the 2026-09-23 VAST DataEnclave release, the 2026-10-01 debt facility with the GPU target raised to 68,000, and the late-October capacity update (secondary only). No pre-release, no reaffirmation 8-K, and no investor-day remarks found.
No ESDS confirmation that its 8,200-GPU B300 cluster went live by 16 Sep 2026, and no ESDS statement on the contract at all.
No EDGAR 8-K after 2026-10-01 (latest filings are 424B3s on 2026-10-07); no ATM or new equity registration found after August.

The October sell-off (-45% between 10-06 and 10-16) has no identified company-specific trigger in EDGAR or the wires; press attributes it to 'potential delays' and a 'funding gap' without a named source.
Sector-ETF relative return into the print: not computed.
Full Q2 call transcript: nasdaq.com returned 503 and stocktaper returned 429 (site-side errors, not a tool budget refusal); used the allmind.ai summary instead.
Dated analyst downgrades: AAII counts 2 in the month to 2026-11-13, but neither was identified by firm.

baseline_tension: Mixed. The negatives (Q3 below the higher consensus, Q4 energisation risk) agree with the +32 put skew and the 59% fall, so they are partly priced. The positives (low real bar, short float doubled to 14.5%, non-dilutive GPU debt) cut against the skew, so the findings net close to zero and p_up sits just under 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 6, disputed bar ($18.3m against $25.3m): Q3 consensus finding capped from -1.0 to -0.8, and p_up moved toward 50 (47 to 48).
Rule 7, crowded short (14.5% of float) against negatives: next-guide finding cut from -2.0 to -1.5 and resale-overhang from -0.5 to -0.4.

Rule 7, sign against the strong skew: expectations/low-bar positive cut from +2.0 to +1.0 and short-interest positive from +1.0 to +0.8, because I cannot say why the +32 put skew is wrong about this print.
Rule 5, an unexplained drawdown is worth 0: the low-bar finding kept only because press attributes a cause (delays/funding), and it was cut as above.
Rule 4, financing is a question: the $356m GPU facility funds a contracted customer cluster, so it stays a small positive (+0.5).
Rule 2, one-offs: convertible fair-value gain cut from +0.3 to +0.2.
Rule 9, net of the rest: the $950m-contract positive cut from +0.5 to +0.4 because it sits on the same Q3 line as the 'month and a bit' negative.
abs_move_pct and print_vs_bar_pct otherwise unchanged (print_vs_bar -10 to -8 on rereading the $950m phase).
